access.title: App access
access.stateUnreadable: Could not read the access status.

access.neverUsedBody: {name} has not signed in to the app yet. You can set a temporary password and share it with them.

access.logged: Every action is logged and the client receives an email notice.

results.notLogged: Warning: the action was not recorded in the log.

noticeReasons.no_email: the client has no email address

createResults.already_linked_other: This account is already connected to another professional: nothing was changed.
createResults.already_linked_self: This client is already connected to you: there was nothing to do.
